name: The reservation model has 1000 attributes and a full reservation is accepted
objective: Verify the data dictionary defines 1000 attributes and a quote carrying all of them is accepted.
steps: Quote a reservation carrying every attribute
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples

name: Advisor views the commission breakdown on the commission statement page
objective: Verify a travel advisor can look up a reservation and see its commission breakdown in the browser.
precondition: A stored GDS reservation; the commission statement page is reachable.
steps: Enter the reservation ID and click "Show commission"
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=GDS; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: Page shows "Commission breakdown", the base commission line and "Total commission"

name: Commission quote p95 response time is within 300 ms
objective: Verify the 95th percentile of 20 full-reservation commission quotes is at most 300 ms.
testData: samples=20; reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples

name: Base commission is 10% of commissionable room revenue
objective: Verify a standard direct reservation earns 10% of its commissionable room revenue.
precondition: Direct booking, 3 nights, BAR rate, 1 room, paid by card.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
Override the commission drivers: standard direct reservation
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 200, effective rate 10% and commission USD 80.00 (10% of USD 800.00)

name: Taxes, resort fees and ancillaries are excluded from commissionable revenue
objective: Verify commissionable room revenue = total - taxes - resort fees - ancillary charges.
precondition: A reservation whose total includes tax, resort fee and ancillary charges.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
Override the commission drivers: revenue.totalAmount 1000.00 with tax 120.00, resort fee 30.00, ancillaries 50.00
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples

name: GDS reservations earn an additional 1.5% channel uplift
objective: Verify a GDS booking is commissioned at 10% base + 1.5% uplift = 11.5%.
precondition: GDS booking, 3 nights, BAR rate, 1 room.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=GDS; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 200, effective rate 11.5% and commission USD 92.00

name: A stay of exactly 7 nights earns the 1.5% long-stay bonus
objective: Verify the long-stay bonus applies at the 7-night boundary ("7 nights or more").
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=7; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 200, effective rate 11.5% and commission USD 92.00

name: A stay of 6 nights earns no long-stay bonus
objective: Verify the long-stay bonus does not apply below 7 nights.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=6; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 200, effective rate 10% and commission USD 80.00

name: Commission is capped at USD 500 per reservation
objective: Verify a reservation whose uncapped commission exceeds USD 500 pays exactly USD 500.
precondition: High-value direct booking: uncapped commission USD 800.00.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
Override the commission drivers: revenue.totalAmount=8000 (no tax, fees or ancillaries)
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=8000; revenue.taxAmount=0; revenue.resortFeeAmount=0; revenue.ancillaryAmount=0; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 200, capped = true and commission USD 500.00

name: Commission is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places
objective: Verify 10% of USD 123.45 (12.345) is rounded half-up, not truncated.
precondition: Direct booking whose raw commission has a third decimal of 5.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
Override the commission drivers: revenue.totalAmount=123.45 (no tax, fees or ancillaries)
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=123.45; revenue.taxAmount=0; revenue.resortFeeAmount=0; revenue.ancillaryAmount=0; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples

name: A stay paid with loyalty points earns no commission
objective: Verify reservations redeemed with loyalty points are not commissionable.
precondition: Direct booking paid with loyalty points.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=true; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 200, eligible = false and commission USD 0.00

name: Cancelled and no-show reservations earn no commission
objective: Verify reservation.status CANCELLED and NO_SHOW both return a commission of 0.
precondition: Two otherwise standard reservations with status CANCELLED and NO_SHOW.
steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)
Override the commission drivers: reservation.status=CANCELLED, then reservation.status=NO_SHOW
testData: reservation.status=CANCELLED | NO_SHOW; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples
expected: Both quotes: HTTP 200, eligible = false and commission USD 0.00

name: Verify: Every commission calculation is written to the commission audit ledger
objective: Confirm the behaviour "Every commission calculation is written to the commission audit ledger." (no executable template in the catalogue - manual verification).
precondition: Access to the system under test and its operational logs.
steps: Perform the action described by the requirement
Observe the outcome in the system or its logs
expected: Every commission calculation is written to the commission audit ledger.

steps: Build a full reservation from the SUT data dictionary (all attributes, dictionary example values)

testData: reservation.status=CONFIRMED; channel.bookingChannel=DIRECT; stay.nights=3; rate.planCategory=BAR; room.roomCount=1; payment.loyaltyPointsRedemption=false; revenue.totalAmount=1000; revenue.taxAmount=120; revenue.resortFeeAmount=30; revenue.ancillaryAmount=50; advisor.iataNumber=; every other attribute of the 1000-attribute reservation from the data dictionary examples

objective: Verify looking up the commission of a non-existent reservation returns HTTP 404.
